narrative.details: <You quickly remove the pendant from the crate and replace the lid.>
narrative.objectives: Bring the strange pendant to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Maps and this... pendant, hm? Interesting.

It is obvious that the Dalaran wizards are interested in Ambermill for some purpose, but still, their aim is hidden to me.

Perhaps Dalar will know something of their use.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you learned anything useful, adventurer?
